headline: Kramatorsk Residents Left Without Heat: Expert Proposes Moratorium on Blocking Thermal Power Plant Accounts
summary: The Kramatorsk Thermal Power Plant cannot fully prepare for the heating season due to blocked accounts and unpaid tariff differences. An expert has proposed a moratorium on blocking the plant's accounts.
why: Thermal power plants supply heat and electricity to cities, and unpaid tariffs and frozen accounts threaten their operating capacity.
